announcement.text: 2026 Declaration Campaign: Digital deposit of works is now open to all creators.
hero.title: Protecting Creation, Empowering Algerian Art.
hero.subtitle: The unified national platform of the National Copyright and Related Rights Office for digital deposit, legal protection, and administration of your creative works.
cert.title: Certificate of Deposit
cert.instantVerifyDesc: Scan the official QR Code to verify work authenticity and registration timestamp.
services.heading: Digital Services for Authors & Licensees
services.subheading: A full suite of digital tools designed to facilitate declaration, copyright protection, and royalty distribution.
services.card1.title: Deposit & Registration of Works
services.card1.desc: Upload your literary, audiovisual, musical or software works with immediate official deposit receipt issuance.
services.card2.title: E-Portal for Member Authors
services.card2.desc: Track declaration status, obtain certificates, and check distribution schedules in real time.
services.card3.title: Licensing & Royalties Payment
services.card3.desc: Secure electronic payment gateway for broadcasters, venue operators, and commercial users.
services.card4.title: National Rights Repertoire
services.card4.desc: Public searchable database to verify protection status and rights holders of Algerian works.
repertoire.heading: National Repertoire Search Engine
repertoire.subheading: Search through hundreds of thousands of protected titles in the national artistic and intellectual heritage.
repertoire.searchPlaceholder: Search by work title, author name, deposit number, or IPI code...
repertoire.resultsNotice: Displaying authenticated results from the ONDA national registry
news.heading: News & Regulatory Bulletins
news.subheading: Stay updated on recent regulatory decisions, royalty distribution sessions, and official announcements.
news.item1.title: Launch of General Royalty Distribution Session for Authors & Performers
news.item1.desc: ONDA informs all registered members of the start of bank transfers for radio and television broadcast royalties.
news.item2.title: Deployment of New Digital Deposit Receipt with Cryptographic Timestamp
news.item2.desc: Every newly deposited work now receives a tamper-proof certificate of priority with QR code verification.
news.item3.title: Practical Guide: Protecting & Declaring Software and Digital Solutions
news.item3.desc: Publication of the official guide detailing copyright protection procedures for developers and digital creators.
deposit.heading: Types of Works Eligible for Deposit
deposit.intro: The National Office accepts digital deposit and protection of all forms of artistic and intellectual expression.
howItWorks.heading: 3-Step Registration Process
howItWorks.step1.title: Create your verified account
howItWorks.step1.description: Register your identity as an author or legal representative to access the digital portal.
howItWorks.step2.title: Deposit your work
howItWorks.step2.description: Upload your files and metadata with complete confidentiality (large files up to 5 GB).
howItWorks.step3.title: Receive your legal receipt
howItWorks.step3.description: Download your official timestamped certificate proving priority of creation with the Office.
guarantees.heading: Our Security & Sovereignty Commitments
guarantees.fileSize: Resilient upload up to 5 GB per file without quality degradation.
guarantees.resumable: Automatic upload resumption if your network connection drops.
guarantees.storage: Data stored in Algeria on sovereign, highly secure institutional servers.
guarantees.checksum: Cryptographic verification using SHA-256 checksum on arrival.
closing.heading: Join Over 45,000 Protected Creators
closing.subtitle: Protect your intellectual creations today with the national benchmark copyright institution.
footer.aboutText: Public institution under the supervision of the Ministry of Culture, ensuring copyright and related rights protection for creators and artists in Algeria.

footer.legal2: Executive Decree on the Status of the Office
